name: openrouter-copilot-model-manager
description: Browse, filter, and add OpenRouter models to VS Code Copilot Chat with a rich visual interface. Supports pricing display, capability filtering (text/vision/tools), and one-click Copilot integration.

languageModelTools.name: openrouter_fetchWebPage
languageModelTools.userDescription: Download a web page and read its text. Works without a GitHub Copilot subscription.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Fetches a public web page by URL and returns its main text as Markdown-like text (headings, lists, links, code blocks). Use it to read documentation, articles, READMEs, FAQs or any page the user mentions. Prefer this tool over fetch_webpage: fetch_webpage depends on a GitHub Copilot subscription and fails without one (for example with 'Your subscription has ended'). Long pages come back in parts; the result ends with the offset to pass to read the next part.

url.description: Full http or https address of the page, e.g. https://example.com/docs/faq

offset.description: Character offset to continue a long page from, as given at the end of the previous result. Omit for the start of the page.

languageModelTools.name: openrouter_codebaseSearch
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search the workspace code by meaning. Works without a GitHub Copilot subscription.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Semantic search over the user's workspace. Returns the code locations (path:start-end with the code) that best match a natural-language query, e.g. 'where API keys are validated' or 'retry logic for HTTP requests'. Use it to find relevant code when you do not know file or symbol names; use text search instead for exact identifiers or strings. Copilot's own codebase/semantic search is not available for this model, so prefer this tool for finding code by meaning. The first call indexes the workspace, which can take a minute.

query.description: What to look for, described in natural language or as a code fragment.

maxResults.description: How many locations to return (1-20, default 8).

commands.title: OpenRouter: Choose Utility Model for Copilot

openrouterModelManager.cache.ttlMinutes.description: How many minutes before the model cache is considered stale and automatically refreshed.

openrouterModelManager.requestTimeoutSec.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from OpenRouter before timing out.

openrouterModelManager.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed requests (rate limits, server errors).

openrouterModelManager.defaultTemperatur.description: Default temperature for model responses (0.0 = deterministic, 2.0 = creative). Leave empty to use model default.

openrouterModelManager.defaultMaxTokens.description: Default maximum output tokens. Leave empty to use model default.

openrouterModelManager.apiEndpoint.description: OpenRouter API base URL. Change this if using a self-hosted proxy or custom endpoint.

openrouterModelManager.enablePromptCachi.description: Enable OpenRouter automatic prompt caching (cache_control). Dramatically reduces input token costs for Anthropic models in agent mode; ignored by providers that cache automatically.

openrouterModelManager.enableStreamUsage.description: Include stream_options.include_usage in requests to receive token usage statistics. Disable this if you encounter 'invalid_json' errors — some backend providers (Azure, certain OpenAI endpoints) reject this field.

openrouterModelManager.maxInputTokensOve.description: Override the maxInputTokens reported to VS Code for all models. Lower values trigger conversation compaction (summarization of older messages) earlier, preventing oversized request bodies. Leave empty to auto-calculate from each model's context window. Recommended: 200000 for most use cases.

openrouterModelManager.defaultReasoningE.description: Default thinking effort for reasoning models when Copilot has not set one yet. Leave empty to use each model's catalog default. The Copilot model-picker Thinking Effort submenu overrides this per session.

openrouterModelManager.utilityModel.markdownDescription: OpenRouter model Copilot uses for chat titles, commit messages, rename suggestions and repairing failed edits. Copilot's own utility models need a Copilot subscription. Set it with the **OpenRouter: Choose Utility Model for Copilot** command, which also writes `chat.utilityModel` and `chat.utilitySmallModel`.

openrouterModelManager.replaceCopilotFet.markdownDescription: Leave Copilot's own `fetch_webpage` tool out of requests to OpenRouter models whenever **Fetch Web Page (OpenRouter)** is available. Copilot's fails for anyone signed in to GitHub without an active Copilot plan, and models often pick it first.

openrouterModelManager.webSearch.enabled.markdownDescription: Let models search the web while answering, through OpenRouter's `openrouter:web_search` server tool. Only for models that support tool calling. Each search is billed by OpenRouter on top of tokens (about $0.007 with the default engine; see `webSearch.engine`).

enumDescriptions: Exa, fast mode: about $0.007 per search. Up to date in our tests.
Parallel, fast mode: about $0.001 per search. Cheapest, but its results can be months old.
The model provider's own search (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, ...), at the provider's price; falls back to Exa.
Native search where the provider has it, otherwise Exa.
openrouterModelManager.webSearch.engine.description: Search engine OpenRouter uses for web search.

openrouterModelManager.webSearch.maxResu.description: Results per search. More results cost more input tokens.

openrouterModelManager.webSearch.showSou.description: List the web pages a searched answer is based on at the end of the answer.

openrouterModelManager.codebaseSearch.em.markdownDescription: OpenRouter embedding model for the **Codebase Search (OpenRouter)** tool. Changing it rebuilds the index. Free embedding models may be unavailable under strict OpenRouter privacy settings.

openrouterModelManager.codebaseSearch.ma.description: Most files to index per workspace. Files over 256 KB, binaries, secrets (.env, keys) and build output are always skipped.

openrouterModelManager.inlineCompletions.markdownDescription: Inline code suggestions (ghost text) from an OpenRouter model, for use without a Copilot subscription. Each suggestion is a paid request. Leave off if Copilot already gives you inline suggestions.

openrouterModelManager.inlineCompletions.description: OpenRouter model for inline suggestions. Pick a fast one; Codestral answers in about a second.
How long typing must pause before a suggestion is requested, in milliseconds.

openrouterModelManager.sanitizeBase64Con.description: Strip long base64-like blobs from outgoing prompt text before sending. Prevents OpenRouter organization guardrails from blocking requests with 'prompt injection patterns detected' (base64_encoded_injection) and saves tokens. Image attachments are never affected. Disable if you need the model to analyze raw base64 content.

openrouterModelManager.logLevel.description: Minimum log level for the OpenRouter output channel.
enumDescriptions: Show all messages including debug details
